rationale: A unanimous, program-specific holding is likely, emphasizing FERA’s post-Allison Engine definition of “claim” (including “whether or not the United States has title”) and the E-rate fund’s federally compelled, pervasively FCC-controlled structure. Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow to avoid converting the FCA into a general antifraud statute for genuinely private pools, with some chance of separate concurrences (especially from Thomas/Gorsuch) to stress textual/originalist limits.
